name: YONEX Co., Ltd.
summary: YONEX Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells sporting equipment in Japan. It offers badminton equipment, such as racquets, shuttlecocks, strings, apparel, shoes, bags, etc.; tennis and soft tennis equipment, including racquets, strings, apparel, shoes, bags, balls, etc.; golf equipment, such as clubs, shafts, junior, apparel, shoes, bags, accessories, etc.; snowboards; off-court, running, and football shoes; and cycles. The company is also involved in golf course management. YONEX Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
